name: diagnosing diabetes overview
title: High glucose: the same cut-offs decide prediabetes or diabetes for both types; below the line sit the grey zone and pre-symptomatic type 1 (autoantibodies), above it the presentation, C-peptide and anti-GAD antibodies separate new-onset type 1 from type 2; each column gives presentation, numbered investigations and treatment in order

root.title: High glucose: is it DIABETES, and WHICH TYPE?
lines: the same cut-offs for type 1 and type 2: they mark where RETINOPATHY risk rises
symptoms (thirst, polyuria, weight loss) → ONE abnormal test is enough · none → repeat on ANOTHER day
acutely ill (heart attack, sepsis, high-dose steroids) → suspect, confirm once recovered

groups.title: BELOW the line: NOT YET diabetes
lines: grey zone: fasting 6.1–6.9 · 2-h 75 g 7.8–11.0 mmol/L · glycated hemoglobin (A1c) 6.0–6.4%

groups.title: AT or ABOVE the line: DIABETES
lines: ANY ONE: fasting ≥ 7.0 · 2-h 75 g or random ≥ 11.1 mmol/L · A1c ≥ 6.5% (adults, NOT if type 1 is suspected)

tiers.title: WHICH TYPE? Usually time and the response to treatment tell
lines: still unsure → C-peptide (is she making insulin?) + anti-glutamic acid decarboxylase (anti-GAD) antibodies

head: h
Prediabetes
impaired fasting glucose (IFG) or impaired glucose tolerance (IGT)
pres: type 2 can sit here for YEARS first
tx: see the PREVENTION OF TYPE 2 DIABETES chart

head: h
Type 1, stages 1–2
beta-cell autoimmunity, NO symptoms yet
inv: • 2 or more: risk climbs with each

head: h
Type 1: new onset (stage 3)
autoimmune beta-cell loss → ABSOLUTE insulin deficiency
pres: Vomiting · abdominal pain · fast breathing · drowsy
→ diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): see the COMPLICATIONS chart

head: h
Type 2
insulin RESISTANCE + RELATIVE deficiency: both present by diagnosis
pres: SLOW: years in the grey zone
• recent weight GAIN, or stopped exercising
• parent with type 2, previous gestational diabetes
• Asian, South Asian, Hispanic, Indigenous, African descent
tx: glucose can fall BELOW the line → recheck periodically
needs drugs: see the GLUCOSE-LOWERING DRUGS tree
